final_used_sources.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: ONE empty photorealistic photographic scene for a premium Instagram/Facebook carousel. This is a compositing background plate only.
Canvas: portrait EXACTLY 1080 pixels wide by 1350 pixels high, aspect 4:5, PNG. Do not add borders.
Primary request: a single perfectly straight front-facing thin satin antique-gold rectangular picture frame attached to a soft warm cream wall. Its opening is a completely empty FLAT UNIFORM NEUTRAL GRAY rectangle, approximately RGB 192,192,192, with an 11:14 portrait aspect ratio. Nothing whatsoever in the gray opening.
Composition: frame centered on the horizontal axis. Inner opening target bounding box: x=210,y=325,width=660,height=840. All four sides exactly vertical/horizontal, no perspective or camera tilt, perfectly rectangular opening, complete frame visible. Very thin refined frame about 10 pixels wide at this output size, clean mitered corners, satin warm pale antique gold, no ornament, no passepartout. Empty wall above opening through y=275 reserved for future text added by another person, empty wall below through y=1350.
Scene: only warm soft cream wall, one empty gold frame, soft natural daylight from an unseen window to upper left. Understated broad window-light falloff at far left, no hard geometric bands or bright hotspot. Nearly smooth fine plaster, clean and lightly tactile, NOT blotchy, no stains. Soft realistic faint shadow to lower right of frame and thin contact shadow that makes frame sit on wall, not float. Gray opening must stay flat neutral gray without sunlight or texture.
Mood: serene, warm, airy, understated luxury, realistic interior photography with restrained cream and muted pale gold tones.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: absolutely NO words, letters, numbers, labels, signatures, watermarks, typography, logos, symbols, zodiac graphics, artwork, line art, poster content, names or captions anywhere. Do NOT render any guide, any bounding box, any measurement, any layout overlay. NO other frames, NO plants, NO books, NO furniture, NO shelves, NO objects, NO decorations. One frame only. The output must be the clean EMPTY SCENE, never a collage or a layout sheet.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is the supplied empty wall/frame photograph. Create ONE matching 9:16 EXTENDED TALL VERSION as an empty compositing background plate, exactly 1080x1920 PNG.
Preserve the exact same quiet cream wall texture, same single narrow satin antique-gold frame style, same gentle upper-left daylight, same subtle shadow to lower right. Extend the wall above/below naturally for a taller portrait crop. Inner gray opening should measure approximately x=210,y=500,width=660,height=840 (11:14 portrait); single frame centered horizontally. Maintain strictly front-on straight 90-degree camera, all four sides perfectly horizontal/vertical, no perspective. Reserve large plain cream wall areas above y=440 and below y=1390 for later screen text. Only one frame, complete and fully visible.
Gray opening MUST be absolutely flat solid UNIFORM #C0C0C0, zero gradient, zero texture, zero glass reflections and no highlights or shadow on the gray rectangle. Frame casts a subtle natural shadow on wall, not inside placeholder. Refined pale muted gold border about10px wide. Wall nearly smooth, fine realistic plaster, not mottled, not stained, no hard bright window bars.
NO text at all. NO lettering, numbers, captions, labels, names, symbols, zodiac signs, poster content, graphics, logos, watermarks, geometry guides or bounding boxes. NO plants, shelves, books, other frames, furniture, curtains, visible window, people, decoration. Only empty wall, daylight and one empty gray frame.

technical_export: Empty generated photographs were aligned and exported to exact dimensions. Placeholder interiors were normalized to flat #C0C0C0 at an exact4:5 aspect ratio, with no inner mat or inset margin. C02 is a133.333333% camera crop of C01. C03 is byte-identical to C01. R02/R03 are105%/110% camera transforms of R01. All delivered inner corner coordinates are integers. No poster, symbol, name, logo or overlay text was rendered.
final_geometry_override: User correction: all final poster openings must be exactly 4:5. Actual source-image frame apertures were normalized to exact4:5 geometry before final delivery. Initial source prompts below are retained only as provenance, not as the final specification.
